environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind a classic ELB with no sticky sessions. TLS terminated at ELB. No additional middleware or reverse proxy. Session cookies are transmitted over HTTPS but the application manages its own session store in-memory. No HSM integration; session IDs are plain random hex strings stored server-side.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB (TCP passthrough for HTTPS)
